name: EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays 2026
summary: The official 2026 menus, read from Disney's Foodie Guide (published Nov 12), with 98 new dishes across 20 Holiday Kitchens. Prices come from Disney's posted menus as reported on Nov 20-21 and cross-checked across four sites; 164 of 176 dishes are priced, and the 12 Disney hasn't priced yet show Coming soon. Dish photos are Disney's own.
location_notes: Kitchen locations are Disney's own 'Location:' lines. A kitchen in a pavilion that also hosts a Food & Wine marketplace is pinned on that marketplace's pin at 'anchored' precision, and says so in `pinned_from`; Refreshment Outpost, Tangierine Café, Swirled Showcase and La Poutinerie are the same venues as in Food & Wine and reuse their pins.
Left unplaced because nothing pins them closely: kitchens on the walkways and near Disney Traders, Port of Entry and the Odyssey, the carts, Connections, Sunshine Seasons and Refreshment Station.

next_step: Twelve dishes still show Coming soon (four Season's Eatings dishes, the Holiday Hearth beer flight and Nocturna cider, Norway's Salted Chai Bolle, and the five spirited drinks). Add each price in the Studio once Disney posts it; a dish with a price drops its 'Coming soon' by itself.
photo_pages_note: Read by `epcot-fw festival photos`. The 2026 photos are already attached, straight from the guide's own cards.
price_note: Prices from Disney's posted menus as reported Nov 20-21, 2026, cross-checked across WDWNT, BlogMickey, DVC Shop and WDW Prep School. A beer or cider sold in two sizes carries its smaller-size price. Dishes without a posted price keep price_note 'Coming soon'.
